Window types

All windows are made from multi-chamber PVC profile with fusion-welded corners and sealed insulated glass units. Any type can be combined into a larger assembly.

Casement

Hinged on the side and cranks open outward. The best seal of any opening window — ideal for bedrooms and living rooms.

Learn more

Awning

Hinged at the top, opens outward from the bottom. Can stay open in the rain; common in kitchens, bathrooms and basements.

Learn more

Picture

Does not open. The narrowest frame and the most glass, for the most light.

Learn more

Fixed

Does not open. From outside it looks like a casement, so it lines up with opening units beside it.

Learn more

Glass

  • Dual or triple glass sealed units
  • Low-E coatings, argon fill
  • Quanex T-Spacer technology
  • Obscure / frosted glass for bathrooms
  • Internal grilles in several patterns

Frame & hardware

  • Multi-point locking hardware
  • Integrated screens
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
  • Custom sizes and shapes

Not sure which type suits your opening?

We'll recommend the right combination during the measurement visit.
